notes.title: Propagation: Paradise Hotel FAQ
notes.content:
[h2]There are only 6 days left before [b][i]Propagation: Paradise Hotel [/i][/b]kicks off and we thought it might be a good time to answer a few of your recurrent questions about the game. Hopefully we cover most of it ![/h2]


[h2][b]IS IT GONNA BE SCARY ?[/b][/h2]
YES. I’m not gonna lie, your stay at the Paradise Hotel will be a little… uncomfortable if I may say. It will be overwhelming and there will be blood. But the thing that is gonna be persistent is the extreme tension. Be prepared to jump out of your skin and hide somewhere safe ! 

[h2][b]IS IT A STATIC WAVE SHOOTER ?[/b][/h2]
NO. How can you find Ashley in the Paradise Hotel without moving ? Get your best shoes on and get ready to move, well at least in the game. But we know some of you might apprehend motion sickness, this is why we’ve included the teleportation option.

[h2][b]IS IT GONNA BE HARD ?[/b][/h2]
IT CAN BE. Obviously we want the Paradise Hotel to be as welcoming as it can be. Whether you are looking for a quiet exploration or a harder challenge, you will be able to choose from 4 difficulty levels : Easy - Normal - Hard - Nightmare. Hopefully it will let all of you have an enjoyable experience. 

[h2][b]HOW MUCH TIME DOES IT TAKE TO FINISH THE GAME ? [/b][/h2]
Depending on how easily scared or distracted by the Hotel’s lovely surroundings you are, you can expect a few hours of tension. But from what we’ve seen so far, the average player will complete the game in about 4 hours on a standard difficulty. It could take up to 7 hours to get all achievements done. Don’t hesitate to tell us about your experience on [url=https://discord.gg/kVq4sXS][u]Discord[/u][/url] !

[h2][b]IS THERE A CO-OP MODE ?[/b][/h2]
NO. And for one reason only, we wanted to create an immersive experience where the player is the only hero of the story. You won’t be able to count on anybody else but yourself to survive inside the Paradise Hotel, and trust me it’s gonna be a real journey.

[h2][b]HOW MUCH IS THE GAME ?[/b][/h2]
Don’t be afraid of the not so clean bedsheets and the lack of food, book your stay at the Paradise Hotel for $19.99 (19,99€). Just make sure to be well fed and well rested before playing and everything will go fine !

notes.title: Gunplay mechanics between PropagationVR & Propagation : Paradise Hotel
notes.content:
[h2]Hello Everyone! 

Let's talk about the evolution of the gunplay mechanics since and the key differences between PropagationVR and Propagation : Paradise Hotel.[/h2]

[h3][b]This reloading mechanic is definitely the feature you asked us for the most![/b][/h3]

Many of you told us that the gun mechanics were not complex enough, so we listened to you for the next Propagation game. 

For us VR technology is a way to immerse you even more in the game. And we sincerely believe that improving the realism of the gun mechanic will get you even more immersed in the game and it will certainly create some terrifying situations!

[h2]Let's take a look at these differences! [/h2]
[b]You can watch this video to get a great overview. [/b]

[previewyoutube=japN6x5vJFY;full][/previewyoutube]
[b]In this video, we can see 2 major differences that we'll cover here! 
[/b]
[h3]The first one is about your aim[/h3] 
As you can see in PropagationVR, shooting while holding your gun with only one hand is really not a difficult. But in Propagation: Paradise Hotel, this mechanic may cause you to lose many bullets. If you want to be accurate and not suffer from the recoil of your weapon, handling it with two hands is necessary! 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38653524/1d1d706b9567cea66dd7536596965c08c5b2f0f8.png[/img]

[h3]The second part is about reloading.[/h3]
In PropagationVR the reloading mechanic is really simple, and you have pretty much nothing to do except to put a new magazine in your gun. But in Propagation : Paradise Hotel you have to master this mechanic if you want to survive. You have to release the magazine before inserting a new one, and after that, please always remember to engage a bullet in the chamber by pulling the slide towards you! Or it can be fatal! 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38653524/7b226edec806fb9cc67ff967c5d11bd35162e18c.png[/img]

[h2]If you liked PropagationVR, feel free to follow the development of Propagation : Paradise Hotel and wishlist the game here: [/h2]
https://store.steampowered.com/app/1824960/Propagation_Paradise_Hotel/
[b]You can also follow and discuss with us on [url=https://discord.gg/kVq4sXS]Discord[/url], [url=https://twitter.com/PropagationVR]Twitter[/url] and [url=https://www.facebook.com/WanadevStudio-340492510171086]Facebook[/url]! 

See you soon! [/b]

notes.title: Propagation VR in CO-OP, now available!
notes.content:
[h3]It's D-Day! You can now get the downloadable content to play Propagation VR in 2-player Co-op mode!
[/h3]
4 months after the release of Propagation VR, we are very happy to see the enthusiastic reception you have given to the game. The community has been extremely encouraging, with nearly 1,500 overwhelmingly positive reviews (96%) today. Thank you all for your support and feedback! We have received many requests for evolutions, and we are delighted to see that you wish to see more and see us go further. One of the recurring requests being to be able to play in multiplayer, we have decided to implement the co-op feature as a DLC.

[previewyoutube=wj6EIdAo0yM;full][/previewyoutube]

This downloadable content adds a “Multiplayer” menu to your Propagation VR experience, allowing you to create and join 2-player games (public or private) with your Steam friends or with anyone in the world! A voice chat is integrated to be able to communicate with your partner and cooperate as best as possible to survive. The bulk of the game is the same, apart from the difficulty levels which have been adapted for 2 players instead of 1, and of course the fact that you will be much more confident with support by your side. Will you make it till the end together?

You can find here a presentation of the game by the studio team (in French):

[previewyoutube=C5xZQhI1TDI;full][/previewyoutube]

The co-op DLC is offered for a base price of $9.99 (take advantage of the launch discount to get it for less) because we are an independent French studio and we are already thinking about the sequel to Propagation VR! [b]The solo Propagation VR experience will stay available for free[/b] because we want to offer this game to a maximum of players.

One of the most prominent request among the community was to add a co-op mode. Another one was to be able to move around in the game. This one unfortunately is not possible in the current game because it was designed to be experienced from a single point of view (for the scenery as well as the artificial intelligence of enemies). [b]We are therefore planning a future exploration game in this same horrific universe that we love so much and which gave you thrills! [/b]We have a lot of ambition for this title so you will have to be patient, but of course we will keep you posted on the next developments.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38653524/687a3eb01f0fd65e598e3b864d274fcfb4fc4a10.jpg[/img]

[h3]With the release of the DLC comes an update to the base game, which includes the following changes:[/h3]
[list]
[*] New “Reset position” option in the menu during the game to recenter the player
[*] Improved navigation of enemies
[*] [Fix] The game could get stuck if the player dies when the boss is in the hole
[*] [Fix] Rotation sensitivity on Windows MR fixed
[*] [Fix] The game misidentified Vive and Quest headsets in some cases
[*] Version number is now displayed in the main menu
[/list]

Your support and feedback allow us to continue to develop games with passion, so thank you! And good luck surviving Propagation VR, in pairs this time. notes.title: New update available for Propagation VR: Improved VFX/SFX!
notes.content:
Hello everyone! Thank you so much for your reviews and comments, we love reading them and hearing what can be improved in Propagation VR. And of course what you would like to see next!

As a first step, taking into account some of your feedback, we are happy to release an update for Propagation VR improving a few aspects of the game :

[list]
[*] Augmented impacts VFX/SFX on zombies and the environment, to improve shooting feeling and help aiming. As a consequence, the game is a bit more gore with more blood splashing around!
[*] Modification of pistol sound
[*] Pistol sight more visible in the dark
[*] Visual improvement to reduce general blur effect
[*] New option "Post-process" in the "Graphics" menu to improve or reduce quality of post-processes depending on your setup
[*] Option "Rotation Speed" in "Game" menu now goes up to x 5.0
[*] New option "Manual Offset" in the "Controls" menu to set your own controller orientation if the auto-setup is not satisfying
[*] Automatically apply specific controller orientations and buttons for Oculus Quest through Virtual Desktop or Link, and Oculus Rift through SteamVR
[/list]

We understood a significant part of our players are using Virtual Desktop / Quest setups and encountered problems with hand orientation and menu button override. We tried our best to improve these aspects, even though not officially supported, in the hope that everyone can enjoy Propagation VR.

Please try out these improvements and tell us what you think! We are still working on Propagation VR so stay close, we will post regular updates about development goals and achievements. You are all invited to share reactions and areas of improvement here, or chat with the dev team on our [url=https://discord.com/invite/DKHk5rQ]Discord channel[/url]!

WanadevStudio's social accounts are also great spots to share your feelings with us. You're welcome to follow us on [url=https://www.facebook.com/WanadevStudio-340492510171086]Facebook[/url], [url=https://twitter.com/WanadevStudio]Twitter[/url] and [url=https://www.instagram.com/wanadevstudio/]Instagram[/url]!

See you soon for more news on Propagation VR!
